# Lease or buy the equipment? Compare the after-tax cost.

> Should your business lease or buy the equipment? Compare the after-tax present-value cost of a loan purchase (with Section 179, bonus or MACRS depreciation and resale value) against a lease, with the lease's implied interest rate and the break-even resale value. Free, private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
